Here in Mbeya the rains are reliable, so maize does well if I care for it properly. I rent this plot, so I must make it count — I will buy one bag of fertilizer, maybe DAP at planting, because my neighbors who use it get better harvests. I cannot afford much, but I will try to use improved maize seed since the shops in town sell it, and I will weed carefully with my family. The plot is small enough that we can manage most of the work ourselves, but I will hire a few hands for the first weeding when the maize is young.
